summary:
Independent, adversarial re-verification of iteration-4's two fixes plus a fresh full top-to-bottom read of both documents, treating every 'confirmed via X' claim with fresh skepticism per the reviewer's mandate.

(1) FIND-010 fix CONFIRMED CORRECT: re-ran `plutil -convert xml1 -o - ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.anicca.daemon.plist` myself right now — the EnvironmentVariables dict genuinely contains exactly 4 keys (ANICCA_HOME, ANICCA_REPO, HOME, PATH), matching the spec's corrected Ground Truth text exactly. Independently re-read `~/anicca/runtime/com.anicca.daemon.plist.template` — identical 4-key set (just templated with __HOME__/__ANICCA_HOME__/__REPO__ placeholders). The spec's new framing (REQ-106's load-bearing invariant = the MECHANISM: add ANICCA_INSTANCE as one more key + verify via a live plutil re-read AT IMPLEMENTATION TIME, not any memorized key list) is sound risk management for a file that has now been shown to legitimately drift mid-review (self-update git-merge + skill rsync, per iteration-2 FIND-005) — it gives an implementer everything needed (the exact file path, the exact key/value pair to add, the exact reload command, and a live-verification step) without depending on a snapshot that could go stale again by implementation time. This does not introduce a new risk; it removes one.

(2) FIND-011 line-number fixes CONFIRMED ACCURATE: registry.json's "earn/clip" entry genuinely starts at line 124 (fields track/dir/entrypoint/status/owner at 125-129, matching the spec's "124-129" citation); run.sh's port-default line is genuinely line 50 (`print(x.get("handle",""), x.get("port",9222)); break`); launch_clip_browser.py is genuinely exactly 15 lines (verified via `wc -l` and full read). All three now correct.

(3) NEW finding (FIND-012, informational, non-blocking): re-reading post_reel.py fresh (not trusting iteration-1's FIND-003 fix), the account-guard citation is ALSO stale — REQ-104/PROP-104 cite lines 117-118 for the active/handle compare and claim line 107 is an unrelated 'not logged in' check; the real file has the compare at lines 104-105, and the real 'not logged in' check at line 94 (line 107 is part of the SAME guard block, not unrelated). Scored informational, consistent with iteration-4's FIND-011 precedent, because the actual code PATTERN cited (querySelector-based active-handle read + fail-closed compare) is genuinely present and correct in the file, and the requirement's operative instruction remains implementable without depending on the specific line number.

(4) Additional fresh spot-checks, ALL independently confirmed accurate against live files/commands (not assumed from prior iterations): `~/anicca/runtime/loop/run-skill.mjs:114`'s `resolveSkillPath` hardcodes `<slot>/run.sh`, never reads `registry.slots[slot].entrypoint` (grep confirms zero other reads of that field outside install.sh); `config.mjs`'s `loadConfig()` allowlist copies only ANICCA_HOME/ANICCA_WALLET_ADDRESS/ANICCA_BALANCE_OVERRIDE/ANICCA_EARN_SKILL/EARN_LEDGER/CLAUDE_BIN into `config`, never writes back to `process.env` (zero matches for `process.env[`/`Object.assign(process.env`/`process.env.X =` anywhere in runtime/loop/*.mjs); `env-filter.mjs`'s scrub regex `/(_WALLET_KEY|_PRIVATE_KEY|_PRIV_KEY)$/` genuinely does not match `ANICCA_INSTANCE`; `anicca-daemon.sh` does not source `.env` (only explicit `export ANICCA_HOME/OPENAI_BASE_URL/OPENAI_API_KEY/ANICCA_WALLET_ADDRESS`); `~/.automaton/wallet.json` real file with `{privateKey, createdAt}` shape confirmed (EVM); ClawRouter's Solana wallet file genuinely does not exist yet; `~/.cloak/clawrouter-clip-solana.json` genuinely deleted from disk; `~/.cloak/myclaude-solana.json` shape confirmed (`pubkey, secret_bytes, chain, owner, created_at, purpose`); `clip-accounts.json` content matches exactly; `_instance_paths.sh`'s suffix logic for all 5 CLIP_* vars confirmed; `tests/test_n_instance_distinctness.sh`'s INSTANCES array confirmed (`"" myclaude clawrouter clawrouter-2`) AND ACTUALLY RE-RUN live just now — ALL PASS (20 paths, 20 unique, 4 instances); `~/anicca/skills/earn/clip/clip-cli.sh`'s STARTUP variable (line 18) confirmed real, currently says `EARN_MODE=execute` with no self-provisioning instruction yet (consistent with the spec's premise that this needs to be ADDED); `run.sh`'s `EARN_MODE=discover` default + `ready_account=none` report on no ready account (line 55-56) confirmed real and matches the mechanism REQ-102 depends on; `ig-account-create/SKILL.md`'s "COMPLETE account = signup + profile (icon + name + bio)" bar confirmed matches REQ-102's cited bar verbatim.

(5) REQ-102 through REQ-107 checked for mutual consistency: no contradictions found. REQ-101 REMOVED / PROP-101 VOID is consistent throughout (no wallet mentioned as in-scope anywhere else); REQ-102's claude-p-only path is consistent with the Purity boundary map and Gate section (which also explicitly excludes the registry/genesis-loop path); REQ-103's hardened validation requirement is reflected in PROP-103's verification method; REQ-104's isolated-browser-login requirement is reflected in PROP-104 (modulo the FIND-012 line-number staleness); REQ-105/PROP-105, REQ-106/PROP-106, REQ-107/PROP-107 all match. The Gate section's items (a)-(d) are all satisfiable given the current spec content.

Given 5 review rounds, a genuinely fresh and skeptical re-check of every prior fix plus new spot-checks across both documents, and only one NEW issue found that is non-blocking under the same rubric already established in iteration-4 — PASS is the correct verdict for both dimensions. This spec has converged.
